notes.title: Volatile Particle is released
notes.content:
After a year of development, Volatile Particle is released!

As a final playtest of the game, our good friend and streamer Nixolay played it [url=https://m.twitch.tv/videos/1970159159]on stream last week[/url]. Watching him play inspired us to add a global leaderboard to the game, and after a hectic week of development, the leaderboard is live! Do you have what it takes to get the #1 spot?

notes.title: Volatile Particle is ready for release!
notes.content: We have been hard at work to get Volatile Particle ready for release. In the last month of development we have added lasers that turn on and off periodically, creating opportunities for levels with more challenge and depth. We have also created a short but sweet original soundtrack for the game. We are exited to release the full game to you on November 15th!
